## Project Structure

- Project root marker: tw.config file
- Source folder: [home]/ (literal brackets — App Router root)
- Components: [home]/components/*.tw
- Layouts: [home]/layout.tw (nested — each directory can have its own)
- Pages: [home]/page.tw, [home]/about/page.tw, etc.
- Dynamic routes: [home]/blog/[slug]/page.tw
- Catch-all routes: [home]/[...slug]/page.tw
- Optional catch-all: [home]/[[...slug]]/page.tw
- Route groups: [home]/(group)/page.tw (no URL segment)
- API routes: [home]/api/*/route.tw
- Libraries: [home]/lib/*.js
- Styles: [home]/style.tss
- Static files: public/ (served as-is)
- Build output: dist/
- Cache dir: .tw/cache/
- Manifest dir: .tw/manifest/
- Middleware: middleware.tw (at project root, [home]/, or [home]/middleware/index.tw)

## File Extensions

- .tw — pages, components, layouts (TW markup)
- .tss — stylesheets (TW Style System)
- .twm — API routes, server-side modules (TW Module)
- .twp — plugins (TW Plugin)
- .js/.ts — client-side libraries
- .json — data files for dynamic routes

## CLI Commands (from cli.py — 1680 lines)

- tw create <name> — create new project (--directory)
- tw init [name] — initialize in current dir (--force)
- tw dev — start dev server at 127.0.0.1:3000 (--host, --port, --no-open, --no-minify, --workers)
- tw build — build to dist/ (--prod, --watch, --analyze, --clean, --adapter, --report, --strict, --workers, --debug)
- tw export — export static site (--out-dir, --workers, --no-minify)
- tw preview — preview built site at port 4173 (--host, --port, --no-build)
- tw serve — production SSR server at 0.0.0.0:8000 (--host, --port, --out-dir, --no-build)
- tw deploy — deploy to cloud (--provider, --vercel, --cloudflare, --prod, --dry-run)
- tw clean — clear cache
- tw doctor — health check
- tw info — project info
- tw ast <file> — show AST (--out, --diagnostics)
- tw ir <file> — show IR (--out, --diagnostics)
- tw run <file> — run file (--out, --diagnostics)
- tw tokens <file> — show tokens (--out)
- tw check <file> — check syntax (--include-ast, --include-ir)
- tw login — login to deploy provider (--provider, --vercel-token)
- tw install <pkg> — install npm package (--dev, --exact)
- tw add <pkg> — add npm package (--dev, --exact)
- tw remove <pkg> — remove npm package
- tw list — list npm packages (--detailed)
- tw plugin add/list/search — plugin management

Global flags: --project-root, --debug, --version

## tw.config Options (indentation-based key:value)

- name: site name
- site_url: base URL (required for sitemap/RSS)
- description: site description
- theme: system | light | dark
- pretty_urls: true/false
- search: true/false
- modular_pipeline: true/false
- allow_raw_script: true/false
- sitemap: true/false (default false — opt-in)
- robots: true/false (default false — opt-in)
- rss: true/false (default false — opt-in)
- auto_image_alt: true/false (default false — opt-in)

## Render Modes

- render static — SSG, build-time HTML (default)
- render server — SSR, per-request server render
- render edge — edge runtime via V8 sandbox
- render interactive — TW native VDOM (~3KB), reactive on demand
- render dynamic — auto-detect static vs server
- render csr — full React CSR, client-side hydration

## Page Block Directives

- title — string
- render — static | server | edge | interactive | dynamic | csr
- revalidate — number (seconds) or string like "60s" (ISR)
- cache_by — cookie:name, header:name, query, or custom
- cache_size — integer (max entries per namespace, default 512)
- generateStaticParams — string path to JSON data file
- redirect — string URL
- rewrite — string URL
- layout — string (DEPRECATED — use file-based layout.tw)

## Runtime Directives (.twm files)

- runtime = "nodejs" (default) — persistent Node.js worker
- runtime = "node" — alias for nodejs
- runtime = "edge" — V8 sandbox via py_mini_racer
- runtime = "edge-v8" — alias for edge
- runtime = "python" — Python in-process
- runtime = "wasm" — wasmtime sandbox
- runtime = "edge-py" — legacy Python edge fallback

## Common API Layer (tw.* — available in all runtimes)

- tw.storage.read(path) — read from storage
- tw.storage.write(path, data) — write to storage
- tw.storage.delete(path) — delete from storage
- tw.storage.exists(path) — check existence
- tw.http.fetch(url, options) — HTTP fetch, returns {ok, status, statusText, headers, text, data}
- tw.http.get(url, headers, timeout) — GET shortcut
- tw.http.post(url, body, headers, timeout) — POST shortcut
- tw.http.put(url, body, headers, timeout) — PUT shortcut
- tw.http.delete(url, headers, timeout) — DELETE shortcut
- tw.crypto.hash("sha256", data) — hash data
- tw.crypto.hmac("sha256", key, message) — HMAC
- tw.crypto.random(length) — cryptographically secure random hex
- tw.crypto.uuid() — UUID v4
- tw.crypto.encrypt("tw-secure", key, data) — authenticated encryption (scrypt + HMAC-SHA256)
- tw.crypto.decrypt("tw-secure", key, data) — authenticated decryption
- tw.cache.get(key, defaultVal) — get from cache
- tw.cache.set(key, value, ttl) — set cache with optional TTL
- tw.cache.delete(key) — delete from cache
- tw.cache.has(key) — check cache
- tw.cache.clear() — clear all cache
- tw.env.get(name, defaultVal) — get filtered env var
- tw.env.all() — get all safe env vars
- tw.env.has(name) — check env var
- tw.runtime.name() — runtime name
- tw.runtime.version() — runtime version
- tw.runtime.capabilities() — capability map
- tw.runtime.supports(cap) — check capability

## Runtime Capability Matrix

| Runtime | Filesystem | Network | Native Modules | Subprocess | Database | Crypto | Cache | Env Vars | Persistent Storage | Timers | Streaming |
|---------|-----------|---------|----------------|------------|----------|--------|-------|----------|-------------------|--------|------------|
| Node.js | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y |
| Edge V8 | N | Y | N | N | N | Y | Y | Y | N | N | N |
| Python | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y | Y |
| WASM | N | N | N | N | N | Y | Y | Y | N | N | N |
| Edge (legacy) | N | Y | N | N | N | Y | Y | Y | N | N | N |

## Security Features (security.py — 388 lines)

- generate_csp_nonce() — cryptographically secure nonce
- build_csp_header(nonce, extra_directives) — CSP with directive dedup
- sanitize_html(html) — XSS prevention, double-escape protection
- sanitize_js_string(js) — JS string sanitization
- sanitize_url(url) — blocks javascript: and data: URLs
- sanitize_attribute(attr, value) — href/src sanitization
- generate_csrf_token() — CSRF token generation
- validate_csrf_token(token, expected) — CSRF validation
- Server security headers: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- Request body size limit (default 10MB, TW_MAX_BODY_SIZE)
- Env var filtering (TW_, PUBLIC_, EDGE_ prefixes only for Edge runtime)
- V8 execution timeout (30s via daemon thread)
- Authenticated encryption (scrypt + HMAC-SHA256, not XOR)
- Null byte removal from inputs

## SSR Cache (server.py)

- SSRCache(max_entries=512) — in-memory LRU with TTL, thread-safe (threading.Lock)
- RedisSSRCache(redis_url, ttl=3600) — Redis-backed, falls back to SSRCache
- Cache namespaces with configurable max entries per namespace
- TW_SSR_CACHE_MAX env var for cache size
- TW_REDIS_URL env var for Redis connection

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| TW_REDIS_URL | — | Redis URL for distributed SSR cache |
| TW_MAX_FETCH_PASSES | 10 | Max HTTP fetch calls per Edge V8 request (1-50) |
| TW_SSR_CACHE_MAX | 512 | Max SSR cache entries |
| TW_AST_CACHE_MAX | 128 | Max AST cache entries |
| TW_AST_CACHE_TTL | 300 | AST cache TTL in seconds |
| TW_MAX_BODY_SIZE | 10MB | Max request body size |

## Middleware System (framework.py)

### Middleware file locations (checked in order):
1. middleware.tw at project root
2. [home]/middleware.tw
3. [home]/middleware/index.tw

### Rule-based middleware:
- match — path pattern (/dashboard/**, /api/**)
- header — add response headers
- methods — restrict HTTP methods
- path — prefixes, contains, extensions, regex, single_segment_max, deny_traversal, deny_null_bytes
- user_agent — allow/block/empty_is_blocked
- origin — CORS: allow/require/allow_referer
- auth — cookie-based, JWT (secret or jwt_secret_env)
- rate_limit — requests, window, identity, bucket_segments (token bucket)
- deny — deny access
- redirect — redirect URL
- rewrite — rewrite URL
- response — status, json, html, text, content_type, headers, cookies

### Function-based middleware:
- fn before(ctx) { ... } — executed before request, can return redirect/rewrite/response
- fn after(ctx) { ... } — executed after request, can modify response

## Plugin System (plugin_runtime.py, plugin_manager.py)

### Plugin format: .twp files
### Lifecycle hooks:
- beforeBuild — modify build config before compilation
- afterBuild — post-build transformations
- beforeRoute — route-level modifications
- afterRoute — post-route processing
- beforeRequest — per-request hooks

### ExtensionManager methods:
- refresh() — discover and load extensions
- discover_extension_paths() — find .twp files
- dependency_paths() — get extension dependency paths
- emit(event_name, **payload) — emit event to all hooks
- register_hook(event_name, handler, extension_name) — register a hook

## Build Pipeline (compiler.py — 6863 lines)

### Stages:
1. Lexing (lexer.py) — tokenize .tw source
2. Parsing (parser.py) — build AST
3. Semantic analysis (semantic.py) — type checking, scope resolution
4. IR lowering (lowering.py) — intermediate representation
5. HTML rendering (render_html.py) — generate static HTML
6. CSS rendering — scoped stylesheets, TSS compilation
7. JS bundling (client_bundler.py) — client-side runtime, code splitting
8. Dead code detection (dead_code.py) — unused pages, components, APIs
9. Tree shaking (tree_shaking.py) — remove unused exports
10. Minification — HTML, CSS, JS minification
11. Output — write to dist/

### Build constants:
- BUILD_MANIFEST_VERSION = 2
- DEPENDENCY_GRAPH_VERSION = 2
- CHUNKS_URL_PREFIX = "/_tw/static/chunks/"
- DEFAULT_WORKERS = max(1, min(32, os.cpu_count() or 1))
- BUILD_MANIFEST_VERSION = 2

### Build options:
- --workers — parallel compilation
- --watch — rebuild on file change (HMR via WebSocket)
- --analyze — bundle analysis
- --report — build report
- --strict — treat warnings as errors
- --adapter — vercel/netlify/cloudflare output format
- --prod — production optimizations (brotli, SRI hashes)

## App Router (app_router.py — 534 lines)

### Route segment types:
- Static: about/ → /about
- Dynamic: [slug]/ → /:slug
- Catch-all: [...slug]/ → /*
- Optional catch-all: [[...slug]]/ → /*?
- Route group: (group)/ — no URL segment

### Special files:
- page.tw — page component
- layout.tw — layout (wraps child pages, supports nesting)
- not-found.tw — 404 page
- error.tw — error page
- loading.tw — loading page
- route.tw — API route (in api/ directory)

### Layout chain:
Layouts are nested — find_layouts_for_dir() walks up from page directory to [home]/, collecting all layout.tw files. children slot is replaced by child page content.

## Module Boundaries (module_boundaries.py — 337 lines)

### Classifications:
- SERVER — .twm files, lib/ modules, database, filesystem, secrets
- CLIENT — npm packages, browser APIs, DOM, WebSocket clients
- SHARED — types, validation, pure utilities

### ImportClassifier methods:
- classify_import(import_path) — classify by import path
- classify_module_source(source, file_path) — classify by source code analysis (with caching)
- validate_imports(imports) — check for boundary violations (TW2000/TW2001)
- get_client_imports(imports) — filter for client bundles
- get_server_imports(imports) — filter for server modules
- scan_source_imports(source, file_path) — scan for import/require/dynamic import()

### Data structures:
- ImportInfo: path, line, col, file, context, boundary, is_dynamic
- BoundaryViolation: code, message, file, line, col, suggestion, severity

### Providers:

- Vercel: vercel.json with build command and routes
- Netlify: netlify.toml with build and redirects
- Cloudflare: _redirects and headers
- GitHub Pages: .nojekyll and base path
- Docker: Dockerfile with Python runtime

tw deploy --provider vercel --prod --dry-run
